title: Glide
summary: One highlight that moves between items instead of each item lighting up on its own. It is the system's signature movement, already built into menus, lists, tabs and the sidebar; use it directly when you build a new set of rows or links.

demos.title: Following the pointer
demos.note: Mark each item with data-glide. Move across the rows, or tab through them: one highlight travels between them instead of each lighting up on its own.

demos.title: Horizontal
demos.note: The highlight takes the size of whatever it lands on, so it works for a row of items of different widths. highlightClassName sets its shape and colour.

demos.title: Following an attribute
demos.note: Pass follow with an attribute name and the highlight tracks whichever child carries it, not the pointer. This is how menus and comboboxes glide under keyboard navigation: they follow the headless component's data-highlighted. Here it follows the selected view.
